concept: EC2 purchasing: 3-year Savings Plans / RIs for steady 24/7 load
tests: Choosing the cheapest option for a predictable, constant workload over 3 years.
expected: Compute Savings Plans or 3-year Standard Reserved Instances — the biggest discount for commitment. Triggers: "steady, predictable 24/7", "next three years".
why_not: On-Demand and On-Demand Dedicated Hosts — no discount; Spot can be reclaimed — not for continuous production.
